title: MEG (Monoethylene Glycol)
description: Industrial monoethylene glycol for antifreeze, coolants, and polyester production.

details.longDescription: Monoethylene Glycol (MEG) supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides industrial-grade MEG for antifreeze, coolants, and chemical manufacturing in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our MEG is essential for formulating automotive antifreeze, HVAC coolants, and as a raw material for polyester fiber and PET production. The colorless liquid provides excellent freezing point depression and boiling point elevation. Critical for gas dehydration, hydrate inhibition in pipelines, and as a heat transfer fluid. Widely used in automotive industries, textile manufacturing, oilfield operations, and industrial cooling systems across Oman. Also serves as a chemical intermediate for resins, solvents, and explosives production.
technicalSpecs: Available in 200L drums, IBCs, ISO tanks, bulk

title: TEG (Triethylene Glycol)
description: High-purity triethylene glycol for natural gas dehydration.

details.longDescription: Triethylene Glycol (TEG) supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides high-purity TEG for natural gas dehydration and industrial applications in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our TEG is the industry standard for removing water vapor from natural gas streams to meet pipeline specifications and prevent hydrate formation. Essential for gas processing plants, glycol dehydration units, and natural gas conditioning. The hygroscopic liquid absorbs water effectively with low vaporization losses. Widely used in gas processing facilities, LNG plants, and oilfield operations across Oman. Also serves as a solvent for resins, inks, and as a plasticizer for vinyl and polyurethane. The preferred glycol for gas dehydration due to optimal balance of performance and economics.
technicalSpecs: Available in drums, IBCs, ISO tanks, bulk

title: Propylene Glycol (USP/Industrial)
description: Food-grade and industrial propylene glycol for various applications.

details.longDescription: Propylene Glycol supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides USP and industrial-grade propylene glycol for food, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our PG is a versatile, non-toxic glycol suitable for food-grade antifreeze, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and industrial processes.
